note: Wooded RV park off I-49 between Carthage and Joplin, with cabins and a small stocked pond. Monthly stays are also sold. --Claude

LONG-STAY (weekly $250+, monthly $550+ marketed; 'Monthly and extended stays welcome'): the five tests pass - (1) $47.50-50; (2) single nights sell on RoverPass with no application; (3) no minimum; (4) Overnight Camping sites free: 19 on Tue 2026-11-17, 27 on Tue 2027-01-26, 33 on Tue 2027-06-08 (RV Life counts 50 sites); (5) not a home community.
